text:
ravin: staging->prod promote blocked: `promote-job` failing with artifact validation. saw `E_TAG_MISMATCH` on registry layer, looks like cache TTL drift. Can we hold the cut? @carmen @jen

deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: Promotion of tag redwood-v2.3.1 halted due to job failure in project inference-service (staging-promote). More info: https://ci.example/1234

carmen: On it. grabbing logs. initial guess: registry returned 206 (Partial Content) with different digest on reupload. :eyes:

jen: If it's digest mismatch we should pin previous artifact and rollback the canary, not hold the whole window. what's the impact to the scheduled 16:00 release? :alarm_clock:

ravin: Canary is at 30% traffic. If we pin to `redwood-v2.3.0-canary` we can keep 16:00 for other services. But infra will need to re-sign the artifact. @liam can you do re-sign?

liam: I can sign and push a replacement blob with a temporary tag `redwood-v2.3.1-fix1`, but need deploybot un-blocked or manual promote. prefer manual to be safe. ETA ~25m.

carmen: Logs snippet:
```
ERROR validating artifact: expected sha256=abc123def4567890.. got sha256=abf124def4567809..
s3 get-object returned 206 Partial Content
```
Suggesting cached part-uploads were served while final write wasn't completed.

jen: Agree manual promote. Also filing a postmortem ticket and updating release notes about transient registry reupload bug. I'll update release notes draft and hold the release window alert.

deploy-bot: Note: Manual promotion accepted by @ravin at 3367890400. Job re-triggered: https://ci.example/1234/retry

liam: Re-signed and pushed `redwood-v2.3.1-fix1` at 3367890500. Manual promote instructions:
`deploybot promote --tag redwood-v2.3.1-fix1 --env prod --force`

ravin: Performing manual promote now. If tests pass we'll proceed with rest of change window. keeping rollback plan: revert to v2.3.0 if anomalies < 15m. :shipit:

jen: Thanks all. I'll ping security to ensure KMS audit has new signing event. postmortem ticket created: INF-3421 :white_check_mark:
